notes: all combat numbers are simulator output on unverified constants

roles.coachLine: Experimental sim build for physical survival: first spike lands around minute 8 (Warp Stream), third item by minute 24. The field wins most with Krix here (60.2% over 854 games).

all.name: Marrow
all.note: Marrow (Major): missing-health-dependent omnivamp; no sustain-uptime model yet

all.name: Nihil
all.note: Nihil (Major): accrual rate depends on combat uptime (how long Doom persists per fight), which the closed-form sim cannot observe

all.name: Aion
all.note: Aion (Major): economy effect; valuable but outside combat objectives (revisit with gold curves)

all.name: Exarch
all.note: Exarch (Major): buffs the HEAL TARGET (usually an ally) — team-side value outside the single-hero sim; self-heal uptime depends on heal cadence vs the 4s window

all.name: Weald
all.note: Weald (Major): execute-window true damage; the headline objectives evaluate full-health targets, so crediting it would overstate sustained output

all.name: Pilow
all.note: Pilow (Major): reduces ENEMY damage output within a radius; the sim models damage taken by one modeled defender, not a team-wide output debuff with uptime

all.name: Knell
all.note: Knell (Major): Only an explicitly supplied active-stack snapshot is modeled; omitted state receives no shred credit. Stack acquisition, refresh/expiry over time, Peal interactions, multi-source behavior and stolen defenses are not simulated. No automatic full-stack uptime or winning-build claim.

all.name: Satariel
all.note: Satariel (Major): stats depend on takedown count (game state), not on the build; crediting any stack count would be an assumption about how the game went
